The manifest for the MCI mailbox (the MCU mailbox, `mcu_mbox0`/`mcu_mbox1`) was accepted on the second submission. It has 3 spec sources and 40 verification sources. The first submission was rejected because the integration spec appeared twice.

- **Spec:**
  - The "MCU Mailbox" sections of `docs/CaliptraSSHardwareSpecification.md`.
  - `src/mci/rtl/mcu_mbox_csr.rdl`.
  - Lines 275–290 of `docs/CaliptraSSIntegrationSpecification.md`, the mailbox SRAM interface rows. I dropped the separate "MCU MBOX SRAM Sizing Requirements" section from the second submission to avoid the duplicate.
- **Verification:**
  - The "MCU MBOX" rows of the subsystem test plan.
  - The `mcu_mbox*` section of the coverage analysis.
  - 27 firmware test sources under `src/integration/test_suites/`, covering both the MCU-side and Caliptra-side files.
